## Specification

Starting from the accepted UX-001 SHA, make the private profile visibly distinguish Fixture tags from Public Live tags. Render the exact truthful badge '演示数据 Fixture' and disclaimer '用于演示流程，不是账号实况' when any rendered tag has data_mode=fixture. Keep the statement self-only and do not change tag values, persistence, source adapters, QA files, or unrelated visual structure. Add a focused SSR regression test. This is a corrective UX task discovered by the strict assembled acceptance gate.

## Acceptance

- A demo profile containing Fixture tags renders the exact badge and disclaimer
- The profile does not misrepresent Fixture tags as verified account activity
- Focused judge-experience tests and diff checks pass
- Only the two owned files change

- `app/templates/profile.html`
- `tests/test_judge_experience.py`
